probe8: Eight seasons at seed 0, baseline against the weather draw: 176,327 events and 1,843 executed acts in both; hashes f29af229d196 and c86cff9bbd1f.
probe_volume: With all four on, event volume rose 7% to 19% (the two seeds); in the other arms it moved from -1.2% to +11.8%. Executed acts moved from -3.8% to +5.5% in every arm, and effective verbs by -0.4 to +1.0; they stay between 10.4 and 11.6. Executed counts in the table include `march` declarations (made or both). No march arrives in any arm. A field is fought in 1 of 14 arm-runs (`field.lost`, seed 1, all four on).
probe_noise: Seeding capability (seed 0) is the one arm with a direct cause: a `train` candidate forms per held vocation, and `train` went from 0 to 14 executions and `oblige` from 33 to 4; `transfer` and `give` dropped out (2 to 0, 1 to 0). Executed verbs range from 29 to 32 across the arms, and the effective-verb figure hides shifts of this size: read per-verb counts, not the headline.
